TV-12-1 (Fisher ET globe valve): no single figure; limited by the ASME B16.34 pressure class of the body (with a packing limit of 104 bar / 1500 psig). GV-12-3, GV-88-1 and GV-88-5 (solenoid globe valves): maximum permissible pressure 6 bar (gauge), i.e. PN6. CHV-46-1, CHV-48-2, CHV-88-1 and CHV-271-1 (Swagelok check valves): no single figure; the highest rating in the datasheet is 6000 psig (413 bar) for CH4/CH8 316 SS bodies at 10-100 °F, lower for other series. BV-48-1 and BV-88-4 (Worcester ball valves): no single figure; e.g. up to 51.8 bar at -30/0 °C for Class 300 Group 1.2 bodies, limited also by seat material. E-271-1 (Alfa Laval M3 plate exchanger, FG frame): 16.0 barg (232 psig) under PED, or 10.3 barg (150 psig) under ASME.
